# Atlantic City: The Most Sensational Game - Teddy Bear Locations

With thanks to Coffee888, Mephiston, and Gaurst.

****SUBJECT TO CHANGE PORTING TO LIVE SERVERS****

Collecting the Batsurri Twin's Teddy Bear is an optional objective during The Most Sensational Game expedition.

There are 5 teddy bear spawns in total, with one spawning every expo.

When you enter the Showmen's Pier, the text on the top right corner of the screen will tell you which bear to look for.

Follow the area search marker on your HUD to the bear spawn location.

When you get close enough to the spawn, it will turn into a map marker.

You will need to hold down A to claim the bear, or the PS and PC equivalent.

When you collect the teddy bear, you will be rewarded with:

150 XP

100 Caps

 __Spawn Locations__

**Quantum Bear**

Follow the map marker to Enter the Aquarium of the Atlantic.

Enter the red double door marked "Arcade" and walk straight. Stop when you get to the open doorway. You should be looking at a pool table on a stage in front of you.

Turn left and the bear is on the rocket ride, in the corner.

**Polar Bear**

Follow the map marker to Enter the Aquarium of the Atlantic.

Stop when you get to the platform with the mannequins, piano, and drum kit.

Turn and face North. Walk forward until you see a window with Christmas lights and a blue and white awning. The bear will be inside, in the fridge. You will be able to see the bear from the window.

**Teddy Fear**

Follow the map marker to Enter the Aquarium of the Atlantic.

Make sure the platform with the mannequins, piano, and drum kit is on your left as you walk past. Just before the doorway is a set of stairs on your left. Walk up the stairs, and the bear will be in the red bin in front of you.

**Comrade Chubs**

Enter the Showmen's Pier, walk through the red double doors, and stop in the middle of the Foyer. Turn left and jump up onto the information desk and then jump up onto the balcony above the information desk. The bear will be sitting in the Red Menace Whac-A-Commie game on your left.

If you can't jump up onto the balcony, walk through the red double doors into the next room. Walk up the stairs in front of you, turn left, and follow the stairs to the top. Turn left again and follow the corridor to the end. Open the door and you will be in the same room as the bear.

**Bubblegum Bear**

Follow the map marker to Enter the Aquarium of the Atlantic.

Stop when you get to the pool table and the Nuka Girl riding the Nuka Cola Rocket. Jump up onto the platform and follow it around.

Stop when you get to the doorway and turn around.

The Bubblegum Bear will be sitting on the window, under the Eat Here sign.
